title: Escher’s Impossible Gravity Sanctuary
summary: An interactive Three.js sandstone citadel with multi-axis gravity where thirty-five lantern bearers walk walls, ceilings, and waterwheels.
description: An interactive Three.js / WebGL2 exhibit and 30-second short film. Thirty-five lantern bearers follow ten routes through a floating sandstone citadel where wall balconies and the ceiling cloister each obey their own local gravity, complete with a three-tier cascade driving a bronze wheel uphill.
